data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'hrollan' meaning 'to wheel' or 'to roll'. This name can also be derived from the Old Norse name 'Rögnvaldr' meaning 'counsel-ruler'. The name Rollie signifies power, strength, and leadership. It is a name of freedom and joy. The name Rollie carries the meaning “Wheel, Ruler, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Rollie usually hope their child will grow to embody wheel, ruler, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
